newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Postabank to start asset swap with APV.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Postabank to start asset swap with APV.

text.p: Hungary's Postabank Rt will start a 17 billion forints asset swap with state privatisation agency APV Rt, government spokesman Elemer Kiss said on Thursday.
"Postabank will give mainly real estate while it will receive minority stakes in already privatised companies," Kiss told a news conference following the weekly government meeting.
He added the move was designed to facilitate the streamlining of Postabank's portfolio ahead of a capital rise later this year.

Kiss said APV and Postabank have started to work out the details of the asset transfer but it will only happen after an international auditor has certified that the assets to be swapped are of identical value.
The registered capital of Postabank was increased by investors to 23.6 billion forints from 16.5 billion at the end of June.
The capital hike increased state influence in the bank, boosting the combined stakes of the two funds, state-owned companies and Szazhalombatta local municipality to above 50 percent.
Oesterreichische Postsparkasse holds a 7.2 percent stake in Postabank while EA Generali AG has 3.9 percent.
